title: Employee Wage Account Groups — Create / Edit
overviewHtml:
The wage account group assigned to the employee from a given date. Saving a new one closes the previous one on the day before the new start date. The same group cannot be recorded twice with the same start date.

It is recorded for reference; the cost engine and journal postings do not read it at present.

fields.label: WageAccGroupId
fields.rules: Required. Chosen from Wage Acc Group master data.
fields.html:
What it is. The wage account group.

Example. Head Office Staff
fields.adminHtml: Maintained under Payroll Management → Wage Account Groups.

fields.label: StartDate
fields.rules: Required. Date value. Saving closes the previous record for the same employee on the day before this date; the latest record stays open.
fields.html: What it is. The first day this record applies.
